MERGE INTO erp_person_year AS target USING (SELECT #{centerCode} AS center_code, #{yy} AS yy, #{mm} AS mm, #{classKey} AS class_key) AS src ON ( target.center_code = src.center_code AND target.yy = src.yy AND target.mm = src.mm AND target.class_key = src.class_key ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET unit_key = #{unitKey}, sub_unit_key = #{subUnitKey}
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (center_code, yy, mm, class_key, unit_key, sub_unit_key) VALUES (#{centerCode}, #{yy}, #{mm}, #{classKey}, #{unitKey}, #{subUnitKey});
